alloy: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u in Generated and u in Differs and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Stale
all u1, u2: Unit | u1->u2 in Share.rel implies u1->u2 in Together.rel
doubt: Share.rel is taken literally as a relation from unit_1 to unit_2 (it is symmetric only by reading).

alloy: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u in Stated and u not in Generated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Handwritten
all u1: Unit, w: Word | (u1->w in Introduce.rel and u1 not in Term) implies w in Misplaced
doubt: The consequent 'the word is declared in a unit that is not a term' is encoded with the Misplaced set, whose reading matches it word for word.

alloy: all s: Series | s in TooLong implies s in AsBullets
all r: Run, c: GenerateCommand, u: Unit | (r->c in Ask.rel and u in Handwritten) implies (u in Reported and r not in Exits0)
doubt: The consequent is read as a conjunction: checker reports the statement and the run does not exit with code 0.

alloy: all f: Fence | (f in Languaged and f in NoSecondWord) implies f in UnitBlock
all u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (u1 != u2 and u2->w in Utter.rel) implies u1->w not in Expose.rel
all p1, p2: Pass | (p1 in TimePhraseInFront and p2 in ClausesInASentence) implies p1->p2 in ahead
all r: Run | ((no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1 or r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits0
all w: Word | (w not in Undeclared and w not in Misplaced and w not in Apart and w not in Unused) implies w not in Flagged
all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and not lists[f, p] and d not in Given) implies p->d not in Over.rel
all s: Series | (s in OneLineRule and s not in TimeFirst and s in TimeSecond) implies s in KeepsThen
all u: Unit | (u in Wordless or u in Twofold) implies u in Unsayable
all p1, p2: Pass | (p1 in FromNowOnWhenever and p2 in ClaimFirst) implies p1->p2 in ahead
all u: Unit | ((u in Logical and u in Generated and u not in Differs and u not in Unsayable and u not in Misread) implies u in Current) and (u not in Logical implies u not in Current)
all u: Unit, s: Signature | (u in Logical and u not in Term and loneOn[u, s]) implies u->s in Expose.rel
all p1, p2: Pass | (p1 in NegationInward and p2 in NounPhrases) implies p1->p2 in ahead
all p1, p2: Pass | (p1 in UntilInASentence and p2 in TimePhraseInFront) implies p1->p2 in ahead
all w: Word | (w in Undeclared or w in Misplaced or w in Apart or w in Unused) implies w in Flagged

(all u: Unit | u in Faulted implies u not in Explained) and (all r: Run, c: Command, u: Unit | (r->c in Ask.rel and (c in GenerateCommand or c in CheckCommand) and u in Faulted) implies r not in Exits0)
all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and lists[f, p]) implies p->d in Over.rel
all b: Bug | (some Tracker and no i: Issue | b->i in Name.issue) implies b in Untracking
doubt: The vocabulary gives no relation from a finding to the unit it is reported for, so 'reports an untracking for the bug' is encoded as membership of the bug in the Untracking set. This is a guess at the intended encoding.

alloy: all d1, d2: Document, u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (d1->d2 in Context.rel and d1->u1 in Hold.units and u1->w in Voice.rel and d2->u2 in Hold.units and u2->w in Introduce.rel) implies w not in Undeclared
doubt: Context.rel is read with its positional gloss: d1->d2 in Context.rel means d2 is context for d1.

alloy: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Stated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Unwritten
all d: Definition | d in NotAboutSubject implies d in AsItStands
all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some s: Signature | u->s in Expose.rel)
all p: Plugin, d: Document, f: Listing | (d->f in Head.rel and no e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel and d not in Given) implies p->d not in Over.rel
all f: Fence, u: Unit | (f in Languaged and f->u in Within.rel) implies u->f in Blocks.rel
doubt: Blocks.rel is oriented unit to fence, as its gloss 'reads {2} as a block of {1}' gives.

alloy: all d: Document, u: Unit, w: Word | (d not in Worded and d->u in Hold.units) implies u->w not in Expose.rel
all u: Unit | u in Current implies u not in Rewritten
all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies c in Unknown
all f: Frontmatter | (f in Misquoted or f in Foreign or f in Unclosed or f in Unterminated or f in Doubled or f in Dangling or f in Looping or f in Stray) implies f in Refused
all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported
all p1, p2: Pass | (p1 in NounPhrases and p2 in ThereIsAThat) implies p1->p2 in ahead
all r: Run, c: LogicCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and ((some s: Scenario | s in Raised) or (some u: Unit | u in Contradicting))) implies r not in Exits0
all s: Scenario, u: Unit | (s in Raised and u->s in Frees.rel) implies s->u in Blame.rel
all u1, u2: Unit | (u1 in Contradicting and u1->u2 in Together.rel) implies u2 in Named

all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) implies r in Exits2) and (((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits1)
all d1, d2: Document, u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (d1->d2 in Context.rel and d1->u1 in Hold.units and d2->u2 in Hold.units and u2->w in Utter.rel) implies u1->w not in Expose.rel
doubt: Context.rel is read with its positional gloss: d1->d2 in Context.rel means d2 is context for d1.

alloy: (all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some s: Signature | u->s in Expose.rel)) and (all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies u in Unchallenged)
all p1, p2: Pass | (p1 in XAndNoOther and p2 in ForEveryTogether) implies p1->p2 in ahead
all w: Word | ((some u1: Unit | u1->w in Voice.rel) and (no u: Unit | u->w in Introduce.rel)) implies w in Undeclared
all s: Series | (s in ListFirstSide and s in PlainSecondSide and s not in Otherwise) implies s in SecondSideFirst

all r: Run | ((some f: Frontmatter, p: Missing | lists[f, p]) or (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) or (some c: Command | r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) or (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits2
doubt: The first two bullets are about the project, not the run; they are read as conditions on every run, and the run is the one universally quantified.

alloy: all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) and not stopped[r]) implies r in Exits1
all s: Search | s in Trial implies (one u1: Unit | s->u1 in Leave.rel and u1 in Held and s->u1 not in Pose.units and (all u2: Unit | (u2 in Held and u2 != u1) implies s->u2 in Pose.units))
all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported
all s: Series | (s in OneLineRule and s not in TimeFirst and s not in TimeSecond) implies s in DropsThen
all p1, p2: Pass | (p1 in ClausesInASentence and p2 in ClaimFirst) implies p1->p2 in ahead
all u1: Unit, w: Word | (u1->w in Voice.rel and (some u: Unit | u->w in Introduce.rel) and u1->w not in Introduce.rel) implies w in Apart
doubt: The consequent is about the word (Apart), since the reading's unit is not a per-unit property in the vocabulary.

alloy: all r: Run, c: LogicCommand | (r->c in Ask.rel and (no s: Scenario | s in Raised) and (no u: Unit | u in Contradicting)) implies r in Exits0
all p1, p2: Pass | (p1 in ClausesInASentence and p2 in NoneOfThese) implies p1->p2 in ahead
all s: Search, sc: Scenario, u1: Unit | (s in Trial and s->sc in Pose.scenario and s->u1 in Leave.rel and (some u2: Unit | sc->u2 in Probe.rel)) implies sc->u1 in Probe.rel
all s: Series | (s in CommaItem and s in MoreThanTwo) implies s in AsBullets
all d1, d2: Document, u: Unit | (d1 in Checked and d1->d2 in Context.rel and d2->u in Hold.units and u in BareFormula) implies u in Held
doubt: Context.rel is read with its positional gloss: d1->d2 in Context.rel means d2 is context for d1.

alloy: all u: Unit | (not used[u] and u not in Conflict and u not in Thread) implies u in Orphaning
doubt: The vocabulary gives no relation from a finding to the unit it is reported for, so 'reports an orphaning for the unit' is encoded as membership of the unit in the Orphaning set. This is a guess at the intended encoding.
